name: Imouto Yuuwaku Ecchi ~Nee, Onii-chan Ecchi Shiyo~
original_name: いもうと誘惑えっち　～ねぇ、お兄ちゃんエッチしよ～
source:
"My little sister can't be this sexy..."

My heart pounded like it was going to burst.

My name is Sho Kunami.
I'm an average college student with average grades.
It pains me to say it but reality is harsh......

For all these years I've never dated anyone.
Fearing a lonely life I finally pulled myself up and signed up for a dating website to try and get a girlfriend.

Why I chose a site instead of a real world pickup bar...
Maybe it was lack of confidence or something, I was still afraid to talk to a girl face to face...
Maybe I just figured one method was as good as another.

My profile got a bite. I wondered what she was like. Her site picture was cute but...

Well, it was too late to think about things like that.

What sort of girl will I be with?
